items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he was supposed to play all the places that Wynton ended up playing on, Wynton Marsalis.

ctx.x: Now as I recall Miles was supposed to play on that album but died before the date, right?
That’s right, he was supposed to play on, “A Time for Love,” he was supposed to play all the places that Wynton ended up playing on, Wynton Marsalis.
So, that would have been your chance, the chance that you never had to work with Miles.
